_comment: org_uid was not a valid UUID, but 'source' (DEFAULT) was recognized — so at job creation, every one of DEFAULT's 12 steps was already seeded NOT_STARTED, straight from the raw request, before INITIAL_REQUEST_VALIDATION itself ever ran. INITIAL_REQUEST_VALIDATION now executes asynchronously like every other step, so this is NOT the direct POST /organizations response (that always returns 202 Accepted, status IN_PROGRESS, regardless of whether the request will go on to fail validation) — this is what a later GET /organization-provision-jobs/{jobId} shows once the async run actually reaches (and fails) INITIAL_REQUEST_VALIDATION. Every other seeded step stays NOT_STARTED (fail-fast). If 'source' itself had been the invalid field, there would be no known step set to seed and 'steps' would have exactly one entry instead of thirteen — see db-rows.md.

steps.name: INITIAL_REQUEST_VALIDATION
steps.errorMessage: org_uid must be a valid UUID
